description: This file implements an image generation service using Fal.ai's API, including class definitions, input parameter models, and methods for generating images from text prompts.

classes.name: FalImageGenService
classes.description: A service class for generating images via Fal.ai's API, inheriting from ImageGenService.

classes.name: FalImageGenService.InputParams
classes.description: A Pydantic model class defining input parameters for image generation, such as seed, inference steps, image size, safety checker, and format.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the FalImageGenService with parameters, HTTP session, model, and optional API key.

methods.name: run_image_gen
methods.description: Asynchronous generator method that creates an image from a text prompt, yielding image frames or error frames.
